T: Not too hot, not too cold.
D: A divorced dad accidentally becomes Santa Claus and has a year to work it out.
P: Serve the cocoa when Judy the elf makes Scott a cup.
S: Brown butter chocolate chip cookies, dough rested overnight for chewy centers
Butter browned and cooled, beaten with brown sugar and egg, flour and choc chips folded in, rested overnight, baked at 180C for 11 minutes. Cold milk on the side.
Mozzarella balls with tomato hats and basil scarves, drizzled with olive oil
Bocconcini stacked three high on a skewer with a cherry tomato hat, black pepper eyes and a basil leaf scarf, drizzled with olive oil.
Scott sets the turkey on fire, so you don't have to

Juicy turkey mince patties with sage and onion, charred on purpose on the grill, in soft slider buns with cranberry sauce and brie. Mix 600g turkey mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 egg and salt. Shape into 12 small patties. Cook on a hot oiled grill pan for 3 minutes a side until charred and cooked through, adding a slice of brie from 150g for the last minute. Toast 12 slider buns and fill with the patties, a spoon of cranberry sauce and rocket.
M: Brined turkey breast rolled with sage butter, stuffing, roast potatoes, gravy
Turkey breast brined overnight, rolled with herb butter, roasted at 170C until 70C, rested 20 minutes, sliced, with stuffing, roast potatoes and gravy.
the diner full of dads who burnt the turkey

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes stacked with crisp bacon, fried eggs and golden hash browns, warm maple syrup and butter on top. Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 375ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 40g melted butter and rest 15 minutes. Bake 8 frozen hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Cook ladles of batter in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side. Fry 4 eggs. Stack 3 pancakes per plate with bacon, an egg and hash browns, then butter and maple syrup.
W: Spiced gingerbread cut into elf shapes
Gingerbread dough of butter, brown sugar, golden syrup, flour and spice, chilled, cut into elves and trees, baked at 180C for 10 minutes and iced in red and green.
K: Cocoa made with milk and cream, cinnamon and vanilla, warmed to drinking heat
Cocoa, sugar and a pinch of salt whisked into milk with a little cream, warmed to drinking temperature with cinnamon and vanilla, never boiled.

note.text: Dad, I know it's really you. You're Santa now, so please don't quit.

winks: The card on the sleigh: put on the suit
A beard that grows back overnight

dishes.make_ahead: Dough up to 2 days, bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the butter in a pan and leave to cool.
Beat with the sugar and egg, then mix in the flour, bicarb and choc chips.
Rest the dough overnight in the fridge.
Shape into 16 cookies and bake at 180C until golden at the edges.
Serve with cold milk.
Crack the peppercorns and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Stack three bocconcini on each skewer and top with a half tomato as a hat.
Press in peppercorn eyes, tie a basil leaf as a scarf and drizzle with olive oil.
Brine the turkey overnight in salted water in the fridge.
Mix the butter with chopped sage, spread over the turkey and roll. Peel and chop the potatoes.
Roast the turkey at 170C until 70C inside, with the potatoes in the tray for the last hour.
Rest the turkey for 20 minutes. Bake the stuffing alongside as the packet says.
Make gravy with the pan juices and stock.

veg.make_ahead: Make the sage butter up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Peel and chop the potatoes.
Mix the butter with chopped sage and rub over the pumpkin. Roast cut side up at 180C for 40 minutes, with the potatoes tossed in the oil in the same tray.
Make up the stuffing mix as the packet says, pack it into the pumpkin hollows and roast another 30 minutes.
Pour the tray butter into a small pan, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer into gravy.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 5 days in a tin

steps.text: Melt the butter, sugar and golden syrup, then stir in the flour, spices and bicarb.
Chill the dough.
Roll out and cut into elves and trees.
Bake at 180C until firm.
Mix the icing sugar with a little water, tint red and green and ice the cooled biscuits.
Whisk the cocoa, sugar and salt with a splash of the milk into a paste.
Add the rest of the milk, cream, cinnamon and vanilla. Warm to drinking temperature without boiling.
Pour into mugs.

s.note: Brown butter chocolate chip cookies, dough rested overnight for chewy centers
s.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Bake 16 cookies at 180C for 11 minutes. Serve with 1L cold milk.

s.note: Mozzarella balls with tomato hats and basil scarves, drizzled with olive oil
s.how: Stack 3 bocconcini on a skewer, about 300g in total, and top with half a cherry tomato as a hat. Press in cracked peppercorns for eyes and tie a basil leaf as a scarf. Drizzle with olive oil. Makes about 8.

m.note: Brined turkey breast rolled with sage butter, stuffing, roast potatoes, gravy
m.how: Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight. Roll with 60g butter mixed with chopped sage and roast at 170C until 70C inside, then rest 20 minutes. Bake a packet of stuffing alongside and roast 1kg potatoes. Make gravy with 300ml stock.

w.note: Spiced gingerbread cut into elf shapes
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp bicarb. Chill an hour, roll, cut into elves and trees and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Ice with 200g icing sugar in red and green.

d.note: Cocoa made with milk and cream, cinnamon and vanilla, warmed to drinking heat
d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa, 4 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt with a splash of milk into a paste. Add 900ml milk, 100ml cream, a pinch of cinnamon and a drop of vanilla. Warm to drinking temperature without boiling and pour.
